ListSql:
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(20), [c].[ID]), [c].[Name], [c].[LegalName], [c].[ShortCode], [c].[IntegrationId], [c].[CompanyType], CASE
    WHEN [c].[ParentCompanyID] IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(varchar(20), [c].[ParentCompanyID])
END, [c].[TerminationDate], [c].[DisplayOrder], [c].[IsDeleted], [c0].[Name], [c].[ID], [c0].[ID], CONVERT(varchar(20), [s].[BrandID]), [s].[BrandID]
FROM [ShiftIdentity].[Companies] AS [c]
LEFT JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Companies] AS [c0] ON [c].[ParentCompanyID] = [c0].[ID]
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT DISTINCT [c2].[BrandID]
    FROM [ShiftIdentity].[CompanyBranches] AS [c1]
    INNER JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[CompanyBranchBrands] AS [c2] ON [c1].[ID] = [c2].[CompanyBranchID]
    WHERE [c].[ID] = [c1].[CompanyID]
) AS [s]
ORDER BY [c].[ID], [c0].[ID]
